title: BBL Compression Garment: How Long to Wear It, Month by Month
meta_description: Day and night except showering for the first month, then at least 12 hours a day in month 2, or as your surgeon directs. Fit, washing and warning signs.
excerpt: Wear the garment day and night, except in the shower, for the first month, then at least 12 hours a day in the second month, or as your surgeon directs. Why the evidence is thin, how it should fit, how to wash it, and which symptoms need urgent care.
quick_answer:
How long do you wear a compression garment after a BBL?

One surgeon interviewed by ASPS advises day and night except showering in month 1, then at least 12 hours a day in month 2. A 2023 review found the evidence on duration is thin, so the schedule your own surgeon gives you comes first.
